paragraphs: Hyman mentions him at the end of Shabbat, chapter 5, according to Korban HaEdah’s reading; the Jerusalem Talmud reads Rabbi Yehudah bar Pazi Rav Dalayah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The de-Vardalya heading and the reported Rav Dalayah wording are kept as the source’s differing designations; no identity or segmentation correction is imposed.

The whole Guggenheimer Shabbat 5:4 final paragraph reads Rabbi Yudah bar Pazi Rav Delayah. Hyman’s Korban HaEdah form de-Vardalya remains his report; the commentary was not freshly collated. Neither the heading nor the digital wording is silently segmented or harmonized into a new identity.
